name: RC-B10-0074/2025 – After § 14 – Am 7
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Russia’s disinformation and historical falsification to justify its war of aggression against Ukraine
part_text: 14a. Recalls that countries forcefully incorporated into the Soviet bloc after World War II never received proper compensation either from Germany or the Soviet Union, despite atrocious damage to their infrastructure and population caused by both totalitarian regimes; calls on the Commission to develop effective mechanisms to ensure a clear, internationally recognised legal pathway for all victims of past and future human rights abuses to make their claims and to allow them to receive reparations from the perpetrating state or its successor;
